pros: Consolidates project information, tasks, and communication in one central place
Simplifies breaking down projects into manageable tasks and stages
Provides clear visibility into project status and team responsibilities with efficient task assignment and tracking
cons: Search and navigation can become challenging with a large volume of historical data
May lack advanced customization or reporting features found in more complex tools, particularly for date-based progress tracking or approval workflows
Can feel too simplistic for highly intricate projects requiring granular control
